subject: FDA June Update - every model update needs its own trail
text:

annotation documentation a legal special control. Combined with CE marking,
eyonis LCS now operates under two parallel post-market documentation
regimes.

The risk: when a regulatory reviewer asks for subgroup-level annotation
evidence behind the last model update, where does that trail live?

We work with Conavi Medical on exactly this: annotation provenance and
audit trail for a regulated imaging AI device.

Is this something you have a process for? Happy to connect this week if
useful.
